| 8〜11℃ | コート | 厚手のコート |

즉 우리 최대 자산 — 골든셋 111행, 4패밀리 교차검증, 표준계약서 오탐 0건 — 은 **분석을 끝까지 돌려야만** 부분적으로 보입니다. 콜드스타트 + 분석에 3분이 걸리는 상황에서, 심사위원이 그 지점까지 도달하지 못하면 우리는 "GPT로 만든 계약서 요약기"와 화면상 구분되지 않습니다.

candidates.author: everforward
candidates.title: You can do the "almost-realtime" part, all locally.
candidates.snippet: You can do the "almost-realtime" part, all locally. I tinkered with a Python script for a few hours that used Whisper to speech-to-text, fed that into a local Mistral model (don't recall which), and then piped the output into text-to-speech. It wasn't really streamed, though. Audio input was buffered, fully evaluated to a string, then fed into the LLM and the full text was converted back to audio. The Whisper speech-to-text was pretty real-time, the LLM was not. I was barely scraping by on hardware specs, though.
candidates.problem: Need for almost real-time speech-to-speech processing using locally run AI models
candidates.selfBuiltSolution: Python script that chains Whisper for speech-to-text, a local Mistral LLM for text generation, and a text-to-speech engine, handling audio in buffered batches
candidates.reasoning: The author describes a concrete, self‑built pipeline that tackles a specific latency‑sensitive workflow unavailable in mainstream cloud services.

candidates.snippet: 一、我想保存的，不只是内容本身 我造了个子站来纪念刘欢。 一首歌可以再听，一段演出可以再看，但我想留下的还包括另一些东西：为什么某首歌会让我想到一张彩票，为什么另一个片尾会连着春节的胡同，为什么有些作品让我明明认识群里的朋友，却一次也没敢申请入群。 这些不是作品资料能替我讲完的部分。所以，把演出影像和听歌故事放在一起的子站（ https://liuhuan.wesing.ai/ ） 除了收录现场演出与MV、综艺高光、纪录片和访谈，也支持登录后留下60秒的歌和一小段话，共同纪念刘欢与他的作品。 配图：子站中文首屏，留下一段最长60秒的声音和一句话说明。 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VulcanFeynman/wesing-liuhu... 这次小项目背后的 wesing.ai（ https://wesing.ai/ ） 是工具主站，却是为了这个子站才仓促上线的。音乐功能尚未添加，现在不能在主站生成音乐。没有必要把它说成已经完成的音乐产品：我只是先把这件私人想做的事做了。 它为什么值得我动手，得从这些歌具体怎样留在我身上说起。 二、有些东西记得不完整，但舍不得把它们缩成一句话 先从一个不太像资深听众的事实说起：我从没看过《宝莲灯》，也没看完《甄嬛传
candidates.problem: Need to preserve personal, contextual memories of music performances beyond just the content (audio/video) by capturing associated stories, emotions, and short audio clips.
candidates.selfBuiltSolution: Created a custom subsite on wesing.ai that integrates performance videos with user‑uploaded 60‑second audio snippets and textual notes, effectively building a personal archival platform.
